biological.citation: Multiple interactions mediate the localization of BLTP2 at ER-PM contacts to control plasma membrane dynamics. (PMID: 39974967)
biological.summary: BLTP2/KIAA0100 is a bridge-like lipid transfer protein that mediates bulk lipid transport between the ER and the plasma membrane (PM). It tethers the ER to tubular endosomes only after they become continuous with the PM, and also tethers the ER to macropinosomes fusing with the PM. Absence of BLTP2 results in accumulation of intracellular vacuoles connected to the PM, demonstrating its role in controlling PM dynamics.

biological.citation: Multiple interactions recruit BLTP2 to ER-PM contacts to control plasma membrane dynamics. (PMID: 40899996)
biological.summary: BLTP2/KIAA0100 binds to the PM through interactions with phosphoinositides, the adaptor proteins FAM102A and FAM102B, and N-BAR domain proteins at membrane-connected tubules. These multiple interactions collectively recruit BLTP2 to ER-PM contact sites. Loss of BLTP2 leads to intracellular vacuole accumulation, many connected to the PM.

biological.citation: KIAA0100 Modulates Cancer Cell Aggression Behavior of MDA-MB-231 through Microtubule and Heat Shock Proteins. (PMID: 29867023)
biological.summary: siRNA-mediated silencing of KIAA0100 in MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells significantly reduced cell aggregation, reattachment, metastasis, and invasion, and sensitized quiescent suspension-culture cells to anoikis. Immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry revealed KIAA0100 acts as a microtubule-binding protein and interacts with the stress protein HSPA1A to confer anoikis resistance.

biological.citation: KIAA0100 Modulates Cancer Cell Aggression Behavior of MDA-MB-231 through Microtubule and Heat Shock Proteins. (PMID: 29867023)
biological.summary: Immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry analysis in MDA-MB-231 cells identified KIAA0100 as a microtubule-binding protein that interacts with the heat shock protein HSPA1A. This interaction contributes to anoikis resistance in breast cancer cells and is proposed as a potential drug target.

biological.citation: Bioinformatic prediction and functional characterization of human KIAA0100 gene. (PMID: 29404013)
biological.summary: CRISPR/Cas9-mediated knockdown of KIAA0100 in U937 acute monocytic leukemia cells inhibited cell proliferation and promoted apoptosis. Bioinformatic analysis predicted the protein contains a signal peptide, transmembrane region, and four FMP27 (fungal mitochondrial protein 27) domains, suggesting localization in the secretory pathway. KIAA0100 is proposed as a novel anti-apoptotic factor and potential immunotherapy target in acute monocytic leukemia.

biological.citation: Circ_0000520 interacts with miR-512-5p to upregulate KIAA0100 to promote malignant behaviors in lung cancer. (PMID: 35866672)
biological.summary: KIAA0100 is a direct target of miR-512-5p; miR-512-5p suppresses lung cancer cell proliferation, migration, invasion, and angiogenesis by downregulating KIAA0100. The circular RNA circ_0000520 acts as a sponge for miR-512-5p, thereby relieving repression of KIAA0100 and promoting lung cancer progression via the circ_0000520/miR-512-5p/KIAA0100 axis. Dual-luciferase reporter assays confirmed the molecular interactions.

biological.citation: Profiling the Somatic Mutational Landscape of Breast Tumors from Hispanic/Latina Women Reveals Conserved and Unique Characteristics. (PMID: 37145128)
biological.summary: Whole-exome sequencing and RNA sequencing of 146 breast tumors from Hispanic/Latina women identified a recurrent copy-number amplification at 17q11.2 associated with high KIAA0100 gene expression. This amplification was more prevalent in Hispanic/Latina women compared to non-Hispanic White women in TCGA and has been implicated in breast cancer aggressiveness.

biological.citation: Preparation of monoclonal antibody against human KIAA0100 protein and Northern blot analysis of human KIAA0100 gene. (PMID: 29404037)
biological.summary: Northern blot analysis in U937 cells revealed that KIAA0100 produces two distinct mRNA products (6000–10000 bp and 5000–6000 bp). Western blot analysis indicated the gene encodes two different protein products (~254 kDa and <250 kDa) in U937 cells. A monoclonal antibody generated against the KIAA0100 protein segment (residues 1557–2234) successfully detected the protein by Western blot and immunocytochemistry.

biological.citation: Identification of BCOX1, a novel gene overexpressed in breast cancer. (PMID: 16289875)
biological.summary: BCOX1, a gene highly homologous to KIAA0100 and located on chromosome 17q11.2, was identified as overexpressed in breast carcinoma. RNA in situ hybridization showed BCOX1 mRNA was absent in normal epithelial cells but progressively elevated from ductal in situ carcinoma (DCIS) to invasive breast carcinoma (IBC) and metastatic breast carcinoma cells, suggesting a role in breast cancer progression.

biological.citation: Bioinformatics-based modeling of lung squamous cell carcinoma prognosis and prediction of immunotherapy response. (PMID: 39724502)
biological.summary: KIAA0100 was identified as one of 11 key genes in a Cox proportional hazards risk prediction model significantly associated with lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC) patient survival, derived from cross-platform gene expression analysis of NCBI GEO and TCGA datasets. The model incorporating KIAA0100 expression showed strong correlation with LUSC prognosis and potential utility for guiding individualized treatment.
